hypothesis: A positive first-15-minute opening drive ending near its high predicts profitable same-day continuation after a full extra five-minute delay, beyond a clock-only long benchmark.
selection_status: Fixed before downloading full histories or calculating this family's performance. No parameter search. Chosen for available aggregate data, not observed strategy returns.
capital_interpretation: Each symbol, period, rule and cost case is an alternative $2000 cash-account simulation, never summed into a portfolio. Reset each period.
price_adjustment: unadjusted actual traded ETF prices; no overnight holdings or cross-day indicators; TQQQ is not synthesized as 3 times QQQ returns
reserved: Do not calculate October 2026 performance. The nine-month 2026 period is not annualized into an achieved annual return. Future paper evidence remains necessary.
data_inspection_disclosure: Before freezing this design, five SPY premarket one-minute bars on 2025-01-02 and SPY daily bars on 2025-01-02 and 2025-01-03 were seen in access/format probes. No strategy return was calculated. These windows are chronological development checks, not certified blind tests.

data_provenance.snapshot_format: connector-exported CSV, with request metadata and SHA-256 manifest; not raw HTTP responses or proof of source truth
data_provenance.access_limitations: 2023 SPY bars, 2025 SPY historical quotes, Benzinga earnings and NES quotes returned NOT_ENTITLED. 2025 SPY minute bars and NES contract metadata were accessible. An initial NES launch-day bar probe was empty.
data_provenance.execution_evidence: Aggregate traded prices only. No NBBO, queue depth, individual fills or point-in-time receipt timestamps. Assumed fills are a price screen, not execution replay.

strategy.opening_range: maximum high minus minimum low of these three completed bars
strategy.signal: 09:40 bar close > 09:30 bar open; body >= 0.25 * range; last close >= range low + 0.80 * range; range > 0
strategy.clock_benchmark: Same rules, opening-range stop, costs and sizing but omit the opening-drive filter
strategy.entry: At the 09:50 bar open, five minutes after all signal bars complete. Exact entry bar required. Skip if entry open <= opening-range low.
strategy.stop: Opening-range low fixed at entry. A completed holding bar closing at or below this stop schedules exit at bar-start + 10 minutes, or the next available regular-session open. No assumed stop-price fill.
strategy.timed_exit: 15:50 regular-session bar open, or next available regular-session open. An unclosed position at session end is an experiment error, never silently dropped.
strategy.risk_exit: A drawdown pause observed at a bar open schedules liquidation at least five minutes later; a close observation schedules at bar-start + 10 minutes. Low prices are retrospective diagnostics and do not trigger trades before they are observable.
strategy.position_sizing: Floor minimum of planned stop-risk quantity (including assumed entry/exit friction and two order fees), 95% marked-equity quantity, and settled cash less overhead reserve and entry fee. Cannot force a minimum share.

settlement.model: Conservative T+1 cash availability: sale proceeds unavailable until the next weekday that is neither a listed exchange closure nor a listed bank-only holiday. Settled cash may fund a new trade; unsettled proceeds may not.
settlement.limitation: This deliberately conservative union calendar is not asserted to reproduce all DTC limited settlement services or broker-specific fund availability.

calendar.missing_data: Validate each expected full trading session exists. Do not forward-fill bars. Missing input bars skip the signal; missing exact entry expires it. Missing holding bars reduce risk visibility; an open position with no later exit bar is an error. Never discard a session because of a later missing bar.

cost_disclosure: 5/10 bps per side jointly proxy spread and slippage; $0.02/$0.04 per order proxy cash trading charges. These and $10/month overhead are assumptions, not verified historical broker fees or guaranteed executable quotes. Monthly overhead continues during a pause. Actual ETF prices embed fund performance; do not separately subtract an expense ratio.
primary_metric: Net period return, observed open/close/low drawdown diagnostic, and candidate return minus clock-only benchmark. Report all 36 cases including failures.
rejection_rules: Opening-drive candidate must be profitable after base costs in BOTH windows AND beat its matching base-cost clock-only benchmark in BOTH windows to advance the selection hypothesis.
Any observed drawdown above 40% fails the risk condition; losses are never clipped.
A surviving bar-price screen would require quotes, size, broker permissions and independent forward validation, not immediate trading.
Assess +1000% only on the full-year 2025 window; do not extrapolate nine months into an achieved annual return.
